codec: MP3 stereo 48000 Hz, 192 kbps, original provider output
transformations: None. Source bytes retained; library applies volume_db=-5.5 without re-encoding.
prompt: An original two-minute instrumental underscore for a contemplative modern grand strategy game. Around 68 BPM, gently shifting harmony, warm low bowed strings, soft breathy woodwind, rounded analog pads, restrained felt piano in its low middle register, very sparse soft percussion. Thoughtful, humane, quietly hopeful, with subtle geopolitical unease rather than triumph. Begin already soft and warm, a patient development in the middle, return to the opening harmonic colour, end in a gentle six-second natural decay. An unobtrusive background mix for long map sessions, no piercing treble or sudden loud accents. No bells, no chimes, no glockenspiel, no celesta, no music box, no bright plucked or metallic tones, no ticking clock, no voices, no choir, no speech, no trailer hits. Do not imitate any existing recording.
acceptance: Decoded, measured and integrated for manual library preview only. Not added to automatic music selection. No listening claim: numerical checks cannot prove absence of all bell-like timbres, voices or artistic defects.
